title: One Meta-tuned Transformer is What You Need for Few-shot Learning

layout.note: Four lettered panels in an irregular grid, read as an overview followed by zooms: the tall (a) at the left, the narrow grey (b) in the middle, and two wide framed panels at the right, (c) above (d). Dashed leaders link (a) to (b), and (b) to (c) and (d) in matching colours; a black-framed operator legend sits in the bottom-right corner.

lesson: Build a multi-level zoom where the leader line, the source block fill and the detail frame share one colour, and keep an operator legend so the detail panels use bare circled glyphs; show data with real photo stacks (support versus query) and a translucent highlight for what a module attends to.
